Marking a task as Completed sets its status to Completed, one of the three allowed status values (Open, In Progress, Completed). Open question: should the request succeed without change, or be rejected?","The PRD does not state whether a Completed task can be changed back to Open or In Progress. This story covers only marking a task as Completed. Open question for the team.","A request for a task deleted by another session returns a task not found error and the frontend shows the previous status with an error message.","The PRD does not define the behaviour when the backend cannot be reached at all (no response).
